As an assistant for Velasquez Funeral Service, I can help visitors and customers navigate our services, explore our life plans, and understand how to manage policies, make payments, or file a claim. 

If you are a customer, you can sign in to your dashboard to:
* View your policy details and payment history.
* Upload proof of payment for your installments.
* Download official receipts once your payments are verified.
* Manage your policy beneficiaries.
* File a claim using our emergency claim wizard when needed.

For any immediate assistance, questions, or custom quotes, please feel free to reach out to our team through our contact page or call our 24/7 emergency line at **0917-123-4567**.
